title: Create setDisplayName mutation
description: Create mutation to set or update a user's display name. Validates: 3-20 chars, alphanumeric + spaces, basic offensive word filter. Links visitorId to user record.

acceptanceCriteria.text: setDisplayName mutation in convex/users.ts or convex/leaderboard.ts
Mutation accepts visitorId and displayName args
Rejects names with only spaces or special characters
Updates existing user or creates new record if needed
